headline.purpose: The single thesis h1, bottom-left of the first viewport, max 24ch.

body.purpose: The quiet declarative lines between the mark and the form.

body-small.purpose: Form text and sent/error confirmation copy.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked field labels; at 0.9rem, the actions (GET IN TOUCH, SEND).

motion.name: fo-breath
motion.purpose: The mark's crescents drift open and settle closed; outer crescents ±3.4 viewBox units, inner ±1.6. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: fo-once
motion.purpose: Applied with fo-breath on the sent-state mark: alternate direction + 2 iterations = exactly one open-and-close breath.

components.name: Send Button
components.description: The only button: square hairline stroke, uppercase tracked label, inverts to cream fill on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: transparent; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); border: 1px solid rgba(229,227,224,0.7); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 32px; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); color: #454f4f; border-color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--cream, #e5e3e0); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Label-over-hairline text field; the bottom border rises from cream/40 to full cream on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 34rem; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-input { background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(229,227,224,0.4); border-radius: 0; padding: 12px 0; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.5; caret-color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgba(229,227,224,0.85); opacity: 1; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-bottom-color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); outline: none; }

components.name: Anchor Action
components.description: The only navigation pattern: an uppercase tracked link over a cream/70 hairline that fills to full cream on hover.
components.css: .ds-link-action { color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(229,227,224,0.7); padding-bottom: 4px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-link-action:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); } .ds-link-action:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--cream, #e5e3e0); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Aperture Mark
components.description: The five-element brand symbol (paths verbatim from the kit), currentColor cream, with the 7s breath on its crescent pairs.
components.css: .ds-mark { width: 180px; color: var(--cream, #e5e3e0); display: block; } @keyframes ds-drift-out { to { transform: translateX(3.4px); } } @keyframes ds-drift-out-small { to { transform: translateX(1.6px); } } @keyframes ds-drift-out-left { to { transform: translateX(-3.4px); } } @keyframes ds-drift-out-left-small { to { transform: translateX(-1.6px); } } .ds-mark-breathe .ds-drift-r-outer { animation: ds-drift-out 7s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) infinite alternate; } .ds-mark-breathe .ds-drift-r-inner { animation: ds-drift-out-small 7s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) infinite alternate; } .ds-mark-breathe .ds-drift-l-outer { animation: ds-drift-out-left 7s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) infinite alternate; } .ds-mark-breathe .ds-drift-l-inner { animation: ds-drift-out-left-small 7s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) infinite alternate; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-mark-breathe g { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The identity is the page. There is no hero headline, no card grid, no second color: a full-bleed brand gradient is the only ground, cream is the only ink, and the five-element aperture mark — paths verbatim from the client's logo kit — is the only graphic. The first viewport belongs to the mark, breathing on a seven-second cycle; the words come after, as a handful of quiet declarative lines on the deep end of the gradient. The refused default is the hero-headline-subhead-CTA landing.

Everything structural is drawn with hairlines: the underline on the anchor link, the bottom borders on form fields, the single-stroke button. No fills, no shadows, no rounded corners, no icons. The system reads as an established, deliberate company because nothing on the page competes with the mark.
keyCharacteristics: One ink (cream #e5e3e0) at varying opacity; the gradient supplies all other color.
The gradient lives on body with svh-unit stops, so copy bands land on the same ground at every document height.
Square corners and hairline (1px) strokes everywhere; zero shadows.
Motion belongs to the mark alone: the crescents' 7s breath, echoed once on the form's sent state.
Uppercase tracked micro-labels (0.14em) are the only typographic ornament.

rules.name: The One-Ink Rule
rules.body: Cream is the only foreground color. Hierarchy and state are expressed through opacity of cream, never through a second hue.

rules.name: The Ground-Is-The-Brand Rule
rules.body: The gradient is painted once, on body, with stops in svh units (0 → 44svh → 72svh → 118svh). Components never paint their own backgrounds; every surface is transparent and sits on the shared ground.

rules.name: The No-Shout Rule
rules.body: Maximum weight is 500 (medium), on the headline only. Everything else is regular. Uppercase appears only with 0.14em letter-spacing at 0.9rem or below — labels and actions, never sentences.

rules.name: The Flat-Water Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. No box-shadow, no overlay surfaces, no cards; the gradient is the only depth in the system.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Strokes are 1px cream, resting at reduced opacity (70% on actionable edges, 40% on idle fields) and rising to full cream on hover/focus. State change is opacity change, animated with a color transition — never thickness, never a new color.

dos: Do paint every new surface transparent and let the body gradient be the ground.
Do draw all structure as 1px cream hairlines, resting at cream/70 (actionable) or cream/40 (idle) and rising to full cream on hover/focus via a color transition.
Do set all text in Hanken Grotesk, weight 400–500, with uppercase reserved for 0.14em-tracked labels and actions at ≤0.9rem.
Do keep the mark as the only graphic and currentColor cream as its only fill; reuse the 7s breath (or the fo-once single-breath echo) as the only motion.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion for any motion, as the breath and smooth scroll already do.
donts: Don't introduce a second ink, an accent color, or semantic reds/greens — errors and confirmations are plain cream text.
Don't add cards, panels, shadows, or rounded corners; the system has zero of each.
Don't exceed weight 500 or the headline's 2.2rem ceiling; type never competes with the mark.
Don't animate anything except the mark's crescents.
Don't redraw or restyle the mark and wordmark paths; they are verbatim from the brand kit (01_Logo).
